newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA fuel oil drops $2, gasoline holds.
newsitem.headline: ARA fuel oil drops $2, gasoline holds.

text.p: ARA fuel oil dropped about $2 a tonne as a couple of sellers sought to shift product, while light gasoline buying kept prices steady.
Eurograde gasoline traded at $203 fob ARA as one major sought to cover a small requirement, traders said. However, weakening futures led swaps levels down over $1 a tonne to $200.50/$201.50 fob ARA.
Weakening IPE gas oil futures had little effect on heating oil buying which remained weak.
"I think the last buyer has gone into his mousehole," one trader said.
Balance of August discussions faded, but first half September deliveries were only thinly discussed, material offered at Sept IPE +$1.00/+$1.25 fob ARA.

High sulphur fuel oil barges traded twice at $96 fob ARA. Some players said the two sellers were eager to see lower numbers. First half September deliveries were bid at $97, but no offers were seen, traders said.
